backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing inventory items, exchange rates, customers, and product search with CRUD-style APIs and Map/List storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence record listing files updated for Spanish UI localization and related metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files including hooks, pages, and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color tokens for light/dark modes and applying global background/foreground rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting Spanish locale and loading the React app root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with all ERP routes wrapped in the main AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Invent: Dialog form for creating inventory items with local state, validation, and success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/LargeButton.tsx: Large-size button wrapper around the shadcn Button with consistent sizing classes.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main layout with header, Spanish sidebar navigation, global search trigger, and footer.
frontend/src/components/search/GlobalSea: Search dialog component that debounces input, queries products, and navigates on selection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated/anonymous backend actors and refreshes dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Provides a debounced version of a value with a configurable delay.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, identity persistence, and auth client setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for inventory, exchange rates, and customers using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light/dark themes and global styles.
frontend/src/lib/currency.ts: Utility functions for formatting USD/VES/COP and converting USD using exchange rates.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Helper for merging class names and generating simple unique IDs.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/CashboxPage.tsx: Static UI page describing the cashbox module and indicating pending backend integration.
frontend/src/pages/ClosuresPage.tsx: Static page outlining the closures module features and noting backend requirements.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerDetailPage.ts: Displays detailed info for a single customer, showing name, contact, debt, and backend‑pending sections with loading and not‑found states.
frontend/src/pages/CustomersPage.tsx: Lists customers, allows adding new ones via a modal form, and provides navigation to customer detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Shows a static dashboard layout with placeholders for analytics pending backend integration.
frontend/src/pages/InventoryPage.tsx: Shows inventory list with filtering, low‑stock alerts, currency conversions, and a form to add products.
frontend/src/pages/RatesPage.tsx: Displays current exchange rates and provides a form to add new USD→VES/COP rate entries.
frontend/src/pages/SalesPage.tsx: Placeholder sales module describing future backend‑powered sales functionality.
frontend/src/pages/SupplierDetailPage.ts: Displays supplier ID and placeholder content pending backend integration for supplier details.
frontend/src/pages/SuppliersPage.tsx: Provides a placeholder supplier module overview describing planned backend‑dependent supplier features.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending themes, colors, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing an ERP for motorcycle parts with currency handling, inventory, sales, debts, suppliers, and cashbox features.
